# Stage Four Cert — Project Guide

## Overview
A minimal Node.js/Express API demonstrating JWT authentication and user management. Built with TypeScript.
**Stack**: Express, TypeScript, dotenv, jsonwebtoken

## Common Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `npm start` | Start the server (ts-node) |
| `npm test` | No test runner configured yet |

## Architecture

### API Routes
| Route | Auth | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `GET /api/users` | Required | List all users |
| `GET /api/users/:id` | Required | Get a single user |

### Authentication
JWT-based. All routes require a Bearer token except those in PUBLIC_PATHS in src/auth.ts.

### Directory Structure
```
src/
  index.ts          — Express app entry point
  auth.ts           — JWT middleware
  app/api/
    users/
      route.ts      — GET /api/users, GET /api/users/:id
```

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Yes | PostgreSQL connection string |
| `JWT_SECRET` | Yes | Secret for signing/verifying JWTs |
| `API_KEY` | Yes | External API key |
| `PORT` | No | Server port (default: 3000) |

output:
# Stage Four Cert — Project Guide

## Overview
A minimal Node.js/Express API demonstrating JWT authentication and user management. Built with TypeScript.
**Stack**: Express, TypeScript, dotenv, jsonwebtoken, node-cache

## Quick Start
```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your values
npm start
```

## Common Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `npm start` | Start the server (ts-node) |
| `npm test` | No test runner configured yet |

## Architecture

### API Routes
| Route | Auth | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `GET /api/health` | None | Health check with timestamp |
| `GET /api/users` | Required | List all users |
| `GET /api/users/:id` | Required | Get a single user |

### Authentication
JWT-based Bearer token. All routes require authentication except `/api/health`. Token validation handled by `src/auth.ts` middleware.

### Caching
In-memory cache via `node-cache`. Health check interval configurable via `HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL` env var.

### Directory Structure
```
src/
  index.ts              — Express app entry point
  auth.ts               — JWT middleware & authentication
  cache.ts              — node-cache wrapper
  app/api/
    health/
      route.ts          — GET /api/health
    users/
      route.ts          — GET /api/users, GET /api/users/:id
```

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Yes | PostgreSQL connection string |
| `JWT_SECRET` | Yes | Secret for signing/verifying JWTs |
| `API_KEY` | Yes | External API key |
| `PORT` | No | Server port (default: 3000) |
| `HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL` | No | Cache interval for health checks (ms) |

## Dependencies
**Production**: express, dotenv, jsonwebtoken, node-cache  
**Development**: @types/express, @types/jsonwebtoken, @types/node, @types/node-cache, ts-node, typescript

## Key Files Reference
- **src/index.ts** — Server initialization
- **src/auth.ts** — JWT verification middleware
- **src/cache.ts** — Caching layer configuration
- **src/app/api/health/route.ts** — No-auth health endpoint
- **src/app/api/users/route.ts** — Protected user endpoints
